verses.original: הַגּוֹרָ֜ל לִבְנֵ֤י יוֹסֵף֙ וַיֵּצֵ֨א מִיַּרְדֵּ֣ן יְרִיח֔וֹ לְמֵ֥י יְרִיח֖וֹ מִזְרָ֑חָה הַמִּדְבָּ֗ר עֹלֶ֧ה מִירִיח֛וֹ בָּהָ֖ר בֵּֽית־ אֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: hag·gō·w·rāl liḇ·nê yō·w·sêp̄ way·yê·ṣê mî·yar·dên yə·rî·ḥōw lə·mê yə·rî·ḥōw miz·rā·ḥāh ham·miḏ·bār ‘ō·leh mî·rî·ḥōw bā·hār bêṯ- ’êl
verses.literal: The allotment for the descendants of Joseph extended from the Jordan at Jericho to the waters of Jericho on the east through the wilderness that goes up from Jericho into the hill country vvv of Bethel

verses.original: וְיָצָ֥א מִבֵּֽית־ אֵ֖ל ל֑וּזָה וְעָבַ֛ר אֶל־ גְּב֥וּל הָאַרְכִּ֖י עֲטָרֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yā·ṣā mib·bêṯ- ’êl lū·zāh wə·‘ā·ḇar ’el- gə·ḇūl hā·’ar·kî ‘ă·ṭā·rō·wṯ
verses.literal: It went on from Bethel ([that is,] Luz and proceeded to the border of the Archites in Ataroth

verses.original: וְיָֽרַד־ יָ֜מָּה אֶל־ גְּב֣וּל הַיַּפְלֵטִ֗י עַ֣ד גְּב֧וּל בֵּית־ תַּחְתּ֖וֹן חוֹרֹ֛ן וְעַד־ גָּ֑זֶר וְהָי֥וּ תֹצְאֹתוֹ יָֽמָּה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yā·raḏ- yām·māh ’el- gə·ḇūl hay·yap̄·lê·ṭî ‘aḏ gə·ḇūl bêṯ- taḥ·tō·wn ḥō·w·rōn wə·‘aḏ- gā·zer wə·hā·yū ṯō·ṣə·ʾō·ṯō yām·māh
verses.literal: Then it descended westward to the border of the Japhletites as far as the border of Lower Beth-horon and on to Gezer and it ended . . . at the Sea
So Ephraim and Manasseh the sons of Joseph received their inheritance

verses.original: וַיְהִ֛י גְּב֥וּל בְּנֵֽי־ אֶפְרַ֖יִם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֑ם וַיְהִ֞י גְּב֤וּל נַחֲלָתָם֙ אַדָּ֔ר עַד־ מִזְרָ֔חָה עַטְר֣וֹת עֶלְיֽוֹן׃ בֵּ֥ית חוֹרֹ֖ן
verses.transliteration: way·hî gə·ḇūl bə·nê- ’ep̄·ra·yim lə·miš·pə·ḥō·ṯām way·hî gə·ḇūl na·ḥă·lā·ṯām ’ad·dār ‘aḏ- miz·rā·ḥāh ‘aṭ·rō·wṯ ‘el·yō·wn bêṯ ḥō·w·rōn
verses.literal: This was the territory of the descendants of Ephraim by their clans . . . The border of their inheritance went from Ataroth-addar . . . in the east to Upper vvv Beth-horon

verses.original: וְיָצָ֨א הַגְּב֜וּל הַיָּ֗מָּה הַֽמִּכְמְתָת֙ מִצָּפ֔וֹן הַגְּב֛וּל וְנָסַ֧ב מִזְרָ֖חָה תַּאֲנַ֣ת שִׁלֹ֑ה וְעָבַ֣ר אוֹת֔וֹ יָנֽוֹחָה׃ מִמִּזְרַ֖ח
verses.transliteration: wə·yā·ṣā hag·gə·ḇūl hay·yām·māh ham·miḵ·mə·ṯāṯ miṣ·ṣā·p̄ō·wn hag·gə·ḇūl wə·nā·saḇ miz·rā·ḥāh ta·’ă·naṯ ši·lōh wə·‘ā·ḇar ’ō·w·ṯōw yā·nō·w·ḥāh mim·miz·raḥ
verses.literal: and out toward - the Sea From Michmethath on the north it turned eastward vvv toward Taanath-shiloh and passed by it to Janoah on the east

verses.original: מִיָּנ֖וֹחָה וְיָרַ֥ד עֲטָר֣וֹת וְנַעֲרָ֑תָה וּפָגַע֙ בִּֽירִיח֔וֹ וְיָצָ֖א הַיַּרְדֵּֽן׃
verses.transliteration: mî·yā·nō·w·ḥāh wə·yā·raḏ ‘ă·ṭā·rō·wṯ wə·na·‘ă·rā·ṯāh ū·p̄ā·ḡa‘ bî·rî·ḥōw wə·yā·ṣā hay·yar·dên
verses.literal: From Janoah it went down to Ataroth and Naarah and then reached Jericho and came out at the Jordan

verses.original: מִתַּפּ֜וּחַ הַגְּב֥וּל יֵלֵ֨ךְ יָ֙מָּה֙ נַ֣חַל קָנָ֔ה וְהָי֥וּ תֹצְאֹתָ֖יו הַיָּ֑מָּה זֹ֗את נַחֲלַ֛ת לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָֽם׃ מַטֵּ֥ה בְנֵי־ אֶפְרַ֖יִם
verses.transliteration: mit·tap·pū·aḥ hag·gə·ḇūl yê·lêḵ yām·māh na·ḥal qā·nāh wə·hā·yū ṯō·ṣə·’ō·ṯāw hay·yām·māh zōṯ na·ḥă·laṯ lə·miš·pə·ḥō·ṯām maṭ·ṭêh ḇə·nê- ’ep̄·ra·yim
verses.literal: From Tappuah the border went westward to the Brook of Kanah and ended . . . at the Sea This was the inheritance of the clans of the tribe vvv of Ephraim

verses.original: וְהֶעָרִ֗ים כָּֽל־ הֶעָרִ֖ים וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽן׃ הַמִּבְדָּלוֹת֙ לִבְנֵ֣י אֶפְרַ֔יִם בְּת֖וֹךְ נַחֲלַ֣ת בְּנֵֽי־ מְנַשֶּׁ֑ה
verses.transliteration: wə·he·‘ā·rîm kāl- he·‘ā·rîm wə·ḥaṣ·rê·hen ham·miḇ·dā·lō·wṯ liḇ·nê ’ep̄·ra·yim bə·ṯō·wḵ na·ḥă·laṯ bə·nê- mə·naš·šeh
verses.literal: - [along] with all the cities and villages set apart for the descendants of Ephraim within the inheritance vvv of Manasseh

verses.original: וְלֹ֣א הוֹרִ֔ישׁוּ אֶת־ הַֽכְּנַעֲנִ֖י הַיּוֹשֵׁ֣ב בְּגָ֑זֶר הַֽכְּנַעֲנִ֜י וַיֵּ֨שֶׁב בְּקֶ֤רֶב אֶפְרַ֙יִם֙ עַד־ הַזֶּ֔ה הַיּ֣וֹם וַיְהִ֖י לְמַס־ עֹבֵֽד׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·lō hō·w·rî·šū ’eṯ- hak·kə·na·‘ă·nî hay·yō·wō·šêḇ bə·ḡā·zer hak·kə·na·‘ă·nî way·yê·šeḇ bə·qe·reḇ ’ep̄·ra·yim ‘aḏ- haz·zeh hay·yō·wm way·hî lə·mas- ‘ō·ḇêḏ
verses.literal: But they did not drive out - the Canaanites who lived in Gezer So the Canaanites dwell among the Ephraimites to this day but they are forced laborers
